rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for ordinary pondering or being lost in thought, rather than explicit daydreaming.

example.english: I muse by the window, thinking about what to do tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我一個人坐喺窗邊諗嘢，諗緊聽日點算。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 co5 hai2 coeng1 bin1 nam2 je5 nam2 gan2 ting1 jat6 dim2 syun3

rows.note: Use this specifically when “muse” means to daydream or drift into imagined scenarios.

example.english: I often muse in class, imagining myself travelling around the world.
example.traditional: 上堂嗰陣我成日發白日夢，幻想自己去環遊世界。
example.jyutping: soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 faat3 baak6 jat6 mung6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 heoi3 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3
